user.title: InkView setup
user.description: Connect this Home Assistant instance to InkView. InkView reads sensor data through a read-only link: it can never control or write to Home Assistant, and the link stays valid for a year unless you extend or renew it. Paste a shared secret generated by your InkView server, or accept the pre-filled one and copy it into InkView.

data_description.secret: Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Both ends need the same value.
data_description.all_sensors: On = InkView can read every numeric sensor (the 'all' option). Turn off to restrict it to a hand-picked list below.
data_description.allowed_entities: Only used when 'Expose all sensors' is off. These are the only sensors InkView can read, and the energy meters among them feed the total-energy figure. If none are picked, InkView can read nothing.
data_description.show_sidebar_panel: Adds an InkView entry to Home Assistant's left sidebar with your energy summary and connection details.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate InkView
reauth_confirm.description: The stored shared secret is no longer accepted. Paste a fresh 64-char hex secret. It replaces the old one, starts a new one-year link, and outstanding tokens stop working.

error.bad_secret: Secret must be 64 hex characters (32 bytes).

abort.already_configured: This InkView connection is already set up.

init.title: InkView options
init.description: Choose which sensors InkView may read. Access is read-only. Energy meters in scope (Wh/kWh/MWh with a total or total_increasing state class) are summed into sensor.inkview_total_energy and shown per day, week, month and year in the InkView panel.

data_description.all_sensors: On = every numeric sensor is readable (the 'all' option). Turn off to restrict to the list below.
data_description.allowed_entities: Only used when 'Expose all sensors' is off. If none are picked, InkView can read nothing.

rotate_secret.name: Rotate shared secret
rotate_secret.description: Generate a new shared secret and start a new one-year link. InkView must be re-linked with the new secret, which admins can copy from the InkView sidebar panel.

revoke_all_tokens.name: Revoke all bearer tokens
revoke_all_tokens.description: Invalidate every outstanding read-only bearer without changing the shared secret.

extend_link.name: Extend link by one year
extend_link.description: Keep the current shared secret working for another year from now.

no_energy_sensors.title: InkView — No energy meters selected
no_energy_sensors.description: InkView's total energy reads 0 because none of the sensors it may read is an energy meter (Wh/kWh/MWh with a total or total_increasing state class). Open the InkView integration options and pick at least one energy meter.

link_expiring.title: InkView link expires in {days} days
link_expiring.description: The link between Home Assistant and InkView ({name}) expires in {days} days. After that InkView can no longer read your sensors. Open the InkView sidebar panel to create a new link and re-link InkView (recommended), or extend the current one by a year.

link_expired.title: InkView link has expired
link_expired.description: The link between Home Assistant and InkView ({name}) has expired, so InkView can no longer read your sensors. Open the InkView sidebar panel to create a new link and re-link InkView, or extend the current one by a year.
